summary:
Seeking an excellent opportunity & proficiency based position in technical and functional areas of
Quality Control enhancement that will provide an-atmosphere conducive to growth and achievement.
+ 8 years competitive experience in electronics manufacturing company.
Currently Job Responsibility: Working as a process quality Engineer
● BOM verification and SOP validation.
● Key process parameters verification and Validate process as per SOP
● Provide a training to the operators as per sop.
● Maintaining the FYP & PY target.
● Maintain daily reports & daily basis data.
● Exceptional team spirit helping in the achievement of desired goals.
● Manpower handling & Line balancing.
● Analysis of Root Cause (5 why) & control process rejection.
● Provide training of new operator and according to new model.
● To achieve ideal production target with quality and full efficiency.
● Meeting daily production targets.
● Maintain daily reports (information , data) as per requirement.
● To conduct training related to manufacturing process, quality and production.
● Responsible for providing on job training to operators.

• Padget Electronics Pvt. Ltd (Dixon)-Padget Electronics Private Limited is a Noida-based
Indian company that specializes in electronics manufacturing services, particularly for mobile
phones and other electronic devices. The company is a subsidiary of Dixon Technologies (India)
Limited and has been operating since 2013. Padget has manufacturing agreements with global
brands like Motorola, Xiaomi, Itel, and Nokia.
• VIVO MOBILE INDIA PVT. LTD- vivo, a premium global smartphone brand, entered India
in late 2014, vivo has established itself as one of the top smartphone brands in India.
